brief: A planter for a sunny kitchen windowsill with three herbs growing in it.

requirements.evidence: Three adjacent full-depth bins (bin:0,0,0, bin:0,-1,0, bin:1,0,0) forming a compact ~260mm long planter body on 3 hex bases, capped and bolted; fits sunny kitchen windowsill footprint.
Each bin filled with soil and planted: basil-young in bin 0,0,0 (prop:1), mint-young in bin 0,-1,0 (prop:2), parsley-young in bin 1,0,0 (prop:3) visible in look.

finish.summary: Linear 3-cell planter with full-depth bins filled with soil and planted with basil, mint, and parsley—suitable for a sunny kitchen windowsill.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
